Multiple Size Options - 8 sizes are available, suitable for more scenes or people of different ages. Baby or pets 32x48 inches, kids 40x50-50x60 inches, teens 50x70-50x80 inches, adults 60x80-70x90 inches.

Fabric and Technology - Flannel fleece blanket is made of 100% microfiber polyester which is very soft, warm and skin friendly. The latest "thermal transfer" printing technology makes the pattern clearly visible and never fades.

Service and Quality - We will help you solve any problem online 24 hours, if the product has quality problem, we will provide you with replacement or refund service. MIHOSI gives you the best guarantee.
